rows.title: Financing to Eni Kenya B.V. for the construction of 4 agri-hubs to collect and process agri feedstock for biofuels production
rows.desc: The purpose of the financing is to support the construction in Kenya of 4 agri-hub dedicated to the collection and pressing of oilseeds (so-called agri-feedstock), as well as the working capital needs related to the supply of the oilseeds by local farmers. The vegetable oils obtained from the extraction process will subsequently be transformed into biofuels. The secondary, but significant, objective consists in the cultivation of oilseed crops in Kenya through the use of low-carbon and climate-resilient agricultural practices, not in competition with the food supply chain, promoting a diversification of agricultural production capable of reducing the exposure of local farmers to climate risks.

rows.sector: Food security policy and administrative management
rows.title: CIHEAM - STRENGTHENING AGRI-FOOD ECOSYSTEMS IN SENEGAL  IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THE ITALIAN PRIVATE SYSTEM
rows.desc: The project intends to contribute to the establishment of economic, technical and institutional ecosystems, oriented to reduce the degree of foreign dependence of the partner country in the field of food security, in line with the agriculture pillar of the Mattei Plan for Africa to develop agri-food chains that favour the resilience of agricultural systems to climate change. To this end, the project intends to implement activities to create a Model Farm to cultivate and manage irrigated areas with local cereal crops and, at the same time, to build socio-community facilities to support local communities, such as schools, first aid centres, housing, canteens and a multifunctional space for sports, recreational and training activities.
